entries.name: Actionable
entries.meaning: A strong leader at a constructive entry with contained risk — the only status the scanner treats as a fresh buy candidate, and only while the market regime is risk-on.

thresholds.label: Regime
thresholds.text: Never produced when the regime is Risk-off — the Risk-off gate forces watchlist-only.

entries.example: Leadership 92 (A), Entry 74 (C), Risk 48 in a Risk-on regime → Actionable.

entries.name: Breakout-watch
entries.meaning: A leader that is not yet at a clean entry — strong enough to watch, but its entry quality is below the Actionable cutoff, so it is a breakout candidate rather than a buy.

thresholds.label: Entry Quality
thresholds.text: Below the Actionable entry cutoff — not yet a clean entry.

thresholds.label: Risk (danger)
thresholds.text: Below the Avoid danger bound, and the name is not Actionable or Extended.

entries.example: Leadership 78 (C), Entry 55 in a Risk-on regime → Breakout-watch.

entries.name: Pullback-watch
entries.meaning: A leader near a buyable area — its entry quality is already at or above the Actionable cutoff, but another Actionable condition is not met, so it is watched for a lower-risk pullback entry.

thresholds.label: Risk (danger)
thresholds.text: Below the Avoid danger bound; Leadership below the Actionable cutoff keeps it a watch rather than Actionable.

entries.example: Leadership 78 (C), Entry 72 (C) in a Risk-on regime → Pullback-watch.

entries.name: Extended
entries.meaning: A strong leader whose entry is extended — too far from a low-risk entry to chase. Wait for a pullback rather than buying here.
entries.example: Leadership 90 (A), Entry 40 in a Risk-on regime → Extended.

entries.name: Avoid
entries.meaning: Not a candidate — either the danger (Risk) is at or above the Avoid bound, or leadership is too weak for any setup.

thresholds.label: or Leadership
thresholds.text: Below the watch cutoff — too weak for any setup.

entries.example: Risk 85 (danger at or above the avoid bound), or Leadership 60 with no qualifying setup → Avoid.

entries.name: Risk-off-watchlist
entries.meaning: The Risk-off gate. When the market regime label is Risk-off, EVERY name is forced to watchlist-only and zero names are Actionable — no matter how strong the individual scores are.

thresholds.label: Regime
thresholds.text: Applies to every name whenever the market regime label is Risk-off (the lowest regime band).

entries.example: Any stock — even Leadership 95 (A), Entry 80 (B), Risk 30 — in a Risk-off regime → Risk-off-watchlist.

entries.name: VCP — Volatility Contraction Pattern
entries.meaning: A price-and-volume base of progressively shallower pullbacks with volume drying up into a pivot near the highs. A detected PATTERN that rides ALONGSIDE the setup status — it never by itself makes a name Actionable.
entries.example: 3 contractions tightening 18% → 9% → 5%, recent volume at 80% of the base, 3% below the pivot → VCP.

intro: How Trendora classifies every stock. Each name gets exactly one setup status (from its three independent scores plus the market regime) and may also carry a detected price pattern that rides alongside it. The thresholds below are read live from this config — they always match the scanner.
